lines.zh: 我抬起身体，一步一步走
lines.en: I rear up and walk, step by step.
My tendrils fan out before me.

lines.zh: 走起来很慢，像潮水推进
lines.en: I move slowly, like a rising tide.
My plates rub together with a thin rasp.

lines.zh: 我沿着海岸线走了一路
lines.en: I've walked the whole shoreline.
Damp ground is my road.
Every so often I stop to listen.

lines.zh: 我的影子长得拖在地上
lines.en: My shadow drags long across the ground.
I drift toward the village.
A slick trail stays behind me.
I walk slowly, but never halt.
My limbs stretch out, slowly.
I go around the puddles, not through.
Wind from the sea; I stop.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只肢，试探地面
lines.en: I lift a limb to test the ground.
I walk toward the sound.
I stand like a wet stone.
I'm waiting for them to speak.

lines.zh: 我的身体记得海的样子
lines.en: My body remembers the shape of the sea.

lines.zh: 触须在空气里慢慢转动
lines.en: My tendrils turn slowly in the air.

lines.zh: 我先学会了说话，才学会别的
lines.en: I learned to speak before I learned the rest.
I remember the first syllable.
It's quiet here. I like it.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很缓，几乎无声
lines.en: My breathing is slow, almost silent.
I lower my head and look at my limbs.

lines.zh: 我听见海在很远的地方
lines.en: I hear the sea, very far off.

lines.zh: 我在想那句话该怎么说
lines.en: I'm considering how to phrase it.
There's an old crack in my shell.
I hold still and let the wind pass.
I know this place isn't mine.
Do you speak?

lines.zh: 我抬起头，正对着你，先说一句。
lines.en: I raise my head to you and speak first.
I speak first. That's courtesy.
I've heard your language before.

lines.zh: 我把触须在身前摆开，像潮水。
lines.en: I spread my tendrils before me like a tide.
Your voice is shaking.
I am the First to Talk. Remember it.
There could be talk between us.
Step back and I won't advance.
I only want to understand you.
I take one step back, steady.
There's a new mark on my shell.
This wound — I can count it.
I lower my head and hold back sound.
Fluid seeps out, salty.
I turn my whole body toward you.
My limbs are going numb.

lines.zh: 疼意让我的话说得更慢
lines.en: Pain makes my words come slower.

lines.zh: 我记住了这一下的位置
lines.en: I've noted where that landed.
I can still stand.

lines.zh: 这些陆上的东西，我不需要。
lines.en: I have no need for these land things.
You hold that out as if testing me.
My food is in the sea.
I glance at it, then look up again.
That won't buy anything from me.
Keep it. It's more use to you.
I don't have that urgency called hunger.
I push it back toward you.
I don't know this smell.
If you want to eat, eat.
I touch you, then draw back.
I'm heavier than I look.
Please, make way.
A slight bump isn't worth noting.
I turn aside to let you through.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，让你从水边过。
lines.en: I turn aside to let you pass by the water.
I stand still until you move on.
We needn't collide.
I retreat half a step; water sounds.
The ground creaks between us.

lines.zh: 我们这种存在，不靠这个
lines.en: Beings like us don't need that.
Among our kind there's only expansion.
I don't seek a mate.
If you've something to say, say it.
I prefer conversation.
Stand back, and we'll talk slowly.
I don't understand your closeness.
The sea takes everything in the end.
Go. I don't keep anyone.
That's not a refusal. Only a fact.
I lift it on the tip of a limb.
I pick it up and study it.

lines.zh: 这个东西，让我多看了一眼。
lines.en: This thing made me look twice.
I set it back down.
I can't grip it well.
What would I do with this?
I hand it back to you.
Its surface is rough.
I've noted its shape.
I don't take what isn't mine.
There are pillagers over there.
I rear up for a clear look.
A witch is chanting behind the trees.
A vindicator raises its axe.
They shouldn't be here.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过去，对准方向
lines.en: I turn slowly, aligning on them.
I can read their movements.
I don't shout. First, the range.
Four of them, spread wide.
This time it must be serious.
I fix on the nearest one.
It raises a crossbow; I wait.
Power gathers inside me.
I don't close in; I strike from afar.
It hides behind a tree; I change angle.
Fifteen paces. Just right.
They're shouting now.
I raise one limb, slowly.
First I take out the one with the crossbow.
My shell is vibrating.
A bolt of force goes out.
My limb sweeps through them.
That caught one in the chest.
They fall back; I follow.
I don't chase far; I hold my ground.
I loose another.
It's thrown into a tree.
My aim is true.
The rest begin to run.
Enough? I think so.
I rise upright from the shallows.
Seawater still runs off me.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次踏上陆地
lines.en: This is my first time on land.
The air is too dry. I'm not used to it.
I spread my limbs and test them.
I try to speak, and no sound comes.

lines.zh: 四周的声音我都记下来
lines.en: I record every sound around me.
The sea withdraws; I stay here.

lines.zh: 我抬起身体，看了看村子
lines.en: I rear up and look at the village.

lines.zh: 我记得我该说第一句话
lines.en: I remember I'm to speak the first words.
Fire burns on my shell; I can't beat it out.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，壳裂了一线
lines.en: I fall from a height and my shell splits.
Water should have been my home.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推得后退几步
lines.en: The blast drives me back several steps.
A crossbow bolt is lodged in my seam.
This spell burns my blood.
Too long from the sea; I'm drying out.
Lightning strikes me and I lock up.

lines.zh: 海嗣的步子很慢，落得更慢。
lines.en: Seaborn steps are slow, and the fall slower.
